name: Emil Toranescu
title: The Pack's Rightful Leader
summary: The grey old werewolf who led the hill pack for nineteen winters and kept it away from the villages, until Kiril came home from the castle with a new law. He said no to stealing children, and Kiril hung him in silver chains for it.

guest_build.note: His own stat block (a werewolf). Joins for the challenge against Kiril; stays only if the Tarokka names him (the Beast).
